5
An atom of element X has 20 protons and 20 neutrons.
An atom of element Y has 19 electrons and a nucleon number of 40.
Which statement is correct?
A
X is an isotope of argon.
B
X is an isotope of neon.
C
Y is an isotope of potassium.
D
Y is an isotope of zirconium.

options.label: A
options.text: X is an isotope of argon.

options.label: B
options.text: X is an isotope of neon.

options.label: C
options.text: Y is an isotope of potassium.

options.label: D
options.text: Y is an isotope of zirconium.
